text: ターンすうが　かかれば　かかるほど　つかまえやすい　ちょっと　かわった　ボール。

structure.jp: ターンすうが　かかれば　かかるほど

structure.en: the easier it is to catch with

structure.jp: ちょっと　かわった

patterns.name: 〜ば〜ほど
patterns.span: かかれば　かかるほど
patterns.explanation: The same verb said twice, first with ば and then with ほど, means 'the more ..., the more ...'. かかれば　かかるほど = 'the more (turns) it takes'.

patterns.name: 〜やすい
patterns.explanation: やすい stuck onto a verb means 'easy to do'. つかまえやすい = 'easy to catch'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.explanation: A verb put right before a noun describes that noun. Everything before ボール in this line describes the Ball. かわった　ボール = 'a Ball that is unusual'.
